authors: I. Jack, D.R.T. Jones, C.G. North
title: N=1 supersymmetry and the three loop gauge beta function
claim: The three-loop gauge beta-function of an abelian N=1 gauge theory is computed in DRED; a coupling redefinition relating it to the NSVZ form is constructed and generalized to the non-abelian case, yielding the non-abelian three-loop DRED gauge beta-function.
theory: N=1 SQED-type abelian theory with Yukawa couplings; inferred non-abelian result
symmetry_argument: SUSY-covariant superspace DRED; the non-abelian result follows from the redefinition ansatz, not from direct non-abelian graphs.

proved: Abelian three-loop DRED gauge beta (direct computation).
assumed: Non-abelian three-loop DRED beta inferred by extending the redefinition (not computed directly).
SUSY of DRED not discussed in the abstract.

red_flags: The non-abelian three-loop DRED result is an inference based on the existence of a DRED->NSVZ redefinition, i.e. it presupposes that DRED and NSVZ are SUSY schemes related by a coupling redefinition.
cross_checks: Detailed in S1e.03_JJN1996c; later direct checks S1e.05_HJKMS2006, S1e.06_JJKM2007.
